BS_ANCIENT_CARD_MERCURY_CARD.title: Mercury
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_MERCURY_CARD.description: When played, copy the cost and effect of the last non-X-cost card you played. If not upgraded, reset at end of turn; if upgraded, do not reset.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_POWER_OF_REWRITE.title: Power of Rewrite
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_POWER_OF_REWRITE.descrip: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Remove all [red]debuffs[/red] from yourself.

BS_ANCIENT_CARD_HLANITH_WINE_CARD.descri: At end of turn, take an extra turn.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_STAGE_END_CARD.title: Stage End
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_STAGE_END_CARD.descripti: Fill your hand and current Energy. Gain {MadnessPower:diff()} [gold]Madness[/gold]. After you play {Cards:diff()} cards this combat, suffer [gold]Forced Death[/gold].
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_RED_QUEEN_BIG_SUCCESS_CA: After combat, gain a rare card reward and you may remove a card.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_RED_QUEEN_MIRROR_CARD.de: Choose one: remove all cards in your discard pile and put copies of all cards in your draw pile into your discard pile; or remove all cards in your draw pile and put copies of all cards in your discard pile into your draw pile. Removed cards do not enter the exhaust pile.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_RED_QUEEN_MIRROR_DRAW_TO: Remove all cards in your discard pile and put copies of all cards in your draw pile into your discard pile. Removed cards do not enter the exhaust pile.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_RED_QUEEN_MIRROR_DISCARD: Remove all cards in your draw pile and put copies of all cards in your discard pile into your draw pile. Removed cards do not enter the exhaust pile.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_CHAOS_FUSION_CARD.title: Chaos Fusion
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_CHAOS_FUSION_CARD.descri: Play the effects of these material cards in random order against random targets: {Materials}.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_CAT_SMILE_CARD.title: Cheshire Cat's Smile
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_CAT_SMILE_CARD.descripti: Gain {Block:diff()} [blue]Block[/blue]. Every [blue]{PlaysForIntangible}[/blue] times this card triggers, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold]. Only one [gold]collar[/gold] card can trigger each turn.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_CAT_BITE_CARD.title: Dinah's Bite
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_CAT_BITE_CARD.descriptio: Remove all [blue]Block[/blue] from an enemy. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Only one [gold]collar[/gold] card can trigger each turn.
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_ALICE_CURSE_CARD.title: 雋ｴ譁ｹ繧呈?縺
BS_ANCIENT_CARD_ALICE_CURSE_CARD.descrip: When exhausted, take {Damage:diff()} damage, draw {Cards:diff()} card, add 1 copy to your draw pile and discard pile, and gain one random effect: [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold], [blue]{UndeadPower}[/blue] [gold]Undead[/gold], [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold], [blue]{MadnessPower}[/blue] [gold]Madness[/gold], or draw [blue]{RandomDraw}[/blue] cards.
